Remark
[symmetry and tensoriality of $L_X abla $]

Source: petersen:page-0080 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-connection

$(L_X abla )(U,V)$ is tensorial in $U$ (since $ abla _UV$ is tensorial in $U$), and it is symmetric in $U,V$; hence it is tensorial in both variables.
Proof

↗ rem:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-connection-symmetric

\sketch Tensoriality in $U$ follows directly from the definition. Torsion-freeness and subsection 1.2 identify the antisymmetric part as

\[ (L_X abla )(U,V)-(L_X abla )(V,U) =L_X(L_UV)-L_{L_XU}V-L_U(L_XV) =(L_XL)_UV. \]

This vanishes by subsection 1.2. Symmetry then transfers tensoriality from the first argument to the second.

□
